headlines.title: 商务部：外国企业对特定二次圆柱形电池、电池组件及包含该组件的产品提起337调查申请
headlines.summary: 7月21日，韩国LG Energy Solution Ltd.、美国LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc.根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定，向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，指控对美出口、在美进口或在美销售的特定二次圆柱形电池、电池组件及包含该组件的产品（Certain Secondary Cylindrical Batteries, Components Thereof, and Products Containing the Same）侵犯其专利权，请求发起337调查并发布有限排除令和禁止令。其中，中国三家企业涉案。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Foreign companies file 337 investigation application for specific secondary cylindrical batteries, battery components, and products containing such components
headlines.summary_en: On July 21, South Korea's LG Energy Solution Ltd. and U.S.-based LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. filed a petition with the U.S. International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the U.S. Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain secondary cylindrical batteries, components thereof, and products containing the same exported to, imported into, or sold in the U.S. infringe their patents, and requesting a Section 337 investigation, a limited exclusion order, and a cease-and-desist order. Three Chinese companies are involved.

headlines.title: 摩根大通：AI板块不太可能是下半年回报的主要驱动力
headlines.summary: 摩根大通策略师认为，随着市场表现向更多板块扩散，科技股或人工智能相关股票下半年不太可能是市场回报的主要驱动力。由Mislav Matejka带领的团队表示，动量交易的抛售可能大部分已经结束，半导体股目前已接近超卖水平该团队在报告中写道：“由于每股收益动能依然向上，这应有助于相关股票企稳”。不过，其预计市场表现将继续向更多板块扩散，并重申，由于地缘政治局势紧张，建议投资者逢低买入。

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan: AI sector unlikely to be main driver of returns in second half
headlines.summary_en: JPMorgan strategists believe that as market performance broadens across more sectors, tech or AI-related stocks are unlikely to be the main driver of market returns in the second half of the year. The team led by Mislav Matejka said the selloff in momentum trades may be mostly over, with semiconductor stocks now near oversold levels. "With EPS momentum still pointing upward, this should help stabilize related stocks," the team wrote in a note. However, they expect market performance to continue broadening across more sectors and reiterated a recommendation to buy the dip given geopolitical tensions.

headlines.title_en: Fed's Williams: Fed policy will not be constrained by markets; optimistic about AI prospects
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - When asked whether the Fed would be constrained by market levels in setting monetary policy, Fed's Williams replied, "Absolutely not," despite the central bank closely monitoring financial markets. Williams said, "We must always independently analyze, do our work seriously, and evaluate all factors affecting the economy and outlook." In addition, Williams holds a positive view on AI development and said recent ups and downs in the industry are not surprising. He noted that asset price volatility is "inherent in this highly innovative, rapidly changing world, and we have seen similar situations in the past." On corporate borrowing for expansion, he said current leverage levels differ from those that led to the financial crisis two decades ago. "These companies are highly profitable, so I am not too concerned about financial stability risks from leverage at the moment."

headlines.title_en: By end of 2025, China's financial leasing industry total assets reach 5.23 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - According to the latest "China Financial Leasing Industry Development Report (2026)" released by the China Banking Association, as of end-2025, there were 64 financial leasing companies in China, with total industry assets of 5.23 trillion yuan, up 7.89% year-on-year. The industry's non-performing leasing asset ratio stood at 0.91%. The industry's asset scale expanded steadily, operational stability continued to strengthen, and overall risk resilience improved steadily. The report shows that in 2025, the financial leasing industry focused on equipment renewal and core manufacturing upgrading needs for business layout, continuously injecting financial momentum into manufacturing transformation and upgrading. By end-2025, direct leasing asset balances in the industry reached 1.84 trillion yuan, up 21.05% year-on-year. In addition, the financial leasing industry actively explored leasing application scenarios in emerging industries such as commercial aerospace and low-altitude economy, with the sci-tech track.

headlines.title: 李强签署国务院令 公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》
headlines.summary: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》，自2026年10月15日起施行。 《条例》旨在保护集成电路布图设计专有权，鼓励集成电路技术创新，促进科学技术发展。《条例》共6章54条，修订的主要内容如下。 一是明确总体要求。规定集成电路布图设计保护工作应当贯彻党和国家知识产权战略部署，扩展保护范围，强调诚实信用。

headlines.title_en: Li Qiang signs State Council decree publishing revised 'Regulations on Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs'
headlines.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang of the State Council recently signed a State Council decree to publish the revised "Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs," effective October 15, 2026. The regulations aim to protect exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs, encourage innovation in integrated circuit technology, and promote scientific and technological development. The regulations consist of 6 chapters and 54 articles, with the main revisions as follows. First, clarifying overall requirements: IC layout design protection work should implement the Party and state's intellectual property strategic deployment, expand the scope of protection, and emphasize good faith.

headlines.title: 全国海洋旅游消费潜力持续释放
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月3日讯，2026年上半年，全国海洋旅游业持续升温，海洋客运量、旅客周转量同比分别增长4.6%、5.4%。自然资源部8月3日发布上半年全国海洋经济数据显示，随着海洋旅游消费潜力持续释放，旅游方式从传统的看海观光向沉浸式、多元化海洋体验转型。“屿见·厦门海上游”系列产品打造船岸联动、海陆互动的海上夜游，青岛海洋旅游联合运营体以“海上+”打造多元沉浸式消费场景，福建东山岛、平潭打造帆船出海、特色海上休闲渔排、风筝冲浪等多元海洋旅游业态。

headlines.title_en: National marine tourism consumption potential continues to release
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - In the first half of 2026, the national marine tourism industry continued to heat up, with marine passenger volume and passenger turnover up 4.6% and 5.4% year-on-year, respectively. Data released by the Ministry of Natural Resources on August 3 on the national marine economy for the first half of the year show that as marine tourism consumption potential continues to be released, tourism models are shifting from traditional sea-viewing sightseeing to immersive, diversified marine experiences. The "Yujian · Xiamen Sea Tour" series of products create ship-shore-linked, sea-land-interactive nighttime sea tours; Qingdao Marine Tourism Joint Operation uses "Sea+" to create diversified immersive consumption scenarios; Fujian Dongshan Island and Pingtan offer diverse marine tourism formats such as sailing, specialty sea leisure rafts, and kite surfing.

headlines.title: 财政部会同农业农村部、水利部下达农业防灾减灾和水利救灾资金21.54亿元
headlines.summary: 据央视，贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，近日，财政部会同农业农村部、水利部下达农业防灾减灾和水利救灾资金21.54亿元。一是支持广西、湖北、湖南、广东、重庆、贵州等6省（自治区、直辖市）开展水利工程设施水毁修复等洪涝、地震灾后救灾工作，助力保障水利工程安全运行。二是支持辽宁、吉林、浙江、广西、湖北等5省（自治区）开展在田作物肥水管理、绝收地块改种补种、畜牧渔业补栏补苗、损毁设施修复等灾后生产恢复工作。三是支持山西、新疆、甘肃等3省（自治区）及时做好农作物改种补种、畜牧补栏等洪涝、风雹灾后救灾工作，加快恢复农业生产。四是聚焦防救衔接，支持河北、内蒙古、吉林

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance, together with Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and Ministry of Water Resources, allocates 2.154 billion yuan for agricultural disaster prevention and water conservancy disaster relief
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV, implementing the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, the Ministry of Finance, together with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Water Resources, recently allocated 2.154 billion yuan in agricultural disaster prevention and water conservancy disaster relief funds. First, supporting six provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) including Guangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Chongqing, and Guizhou in carrying out post-flood and post-earthquake disaster relief work such as repairing damaged water conservancy facilities, helping ensure the safe operation of water conservancy projects. Second, supporting five provinces (autonomous regions) including Liaoning, Jilin, Zhejiang, Guangxi, and Hubei in carrying out post-disaster production recovery work such as fertilizer and water management for standing crops, replanting and resowing on failed plots, restocking livestock and aquaculture seedlings, and repairing damaged facilities. Third, supporting three provinces (autonomous regions) including Shanxi, Xinjiang, and Gansu in promptly carrying out post-flood and post-hail disaster relief work such as crop replanting and resowing and livestock restocking to accelerate agricultural production recovery. Fourth, focusing on linking prevention and rescue, supporting Hebei, Inner Mongolia, and Jilin

headlines.title: 联合国工发组织食品行业检验检测能力建设与提升培训计划收官

headlines.title_en: UNIDO food industry inspection and testing capacity building and enhancement training program concludes
headlines.summary_en: The reporter learned today that the "Quality Enhancement and Protection · Silk Road Common Trust" food industry inspection and testing capacity building and improvement training program, jointly guided and implemented by the State Administration for Market Regulation (National Certification and Accreditation Administration) and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), concluded in Beijing. The training program aims to deeply practice the Belt and Road Initiative and promote international collaborative governance of food safety. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 国家知识产权局副局长张志成会见中国美国商会会长一行
headlines.summary: 近日，中国国家知识产权局副局长张志成在京会见来访的中国美国商会会长何迈可和会员企业代表。张志成表示，近年来，中国依法严格保护国内外企业知识产权，做到一视同仁、同等保护，努力为各国企业和创新主体营造公平竞争的发展环境。中国国家知识产权局愿意倾听业界声音，了解外资企业在知识产权方面的需求，有针对性地做好相关工作。何迈可表示，近年来，中国知识产权保护取得长足进展，为外资企业发展提供了良好环境。中国美国商会希望与中国国家知识产权局继续保持沟通并将持续鼓励会员企业坚定信心，投资中国。

headlines.title_en: Deputy Director Zhang Zhicheng of CNIPA Meets with AmCham China President and Delegation
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Zhang Zhicheng, Deputy Commissioner of the China National Intellectual Property Administration, met in Beijing with Michael Hart, President of AmCham China, and representatives of member companies. Zhang said that in recent years, China has strictly protected the intellectual property rights of domestic and foreign enterprises in accordance with the law, treating all equally and providing equal protection, striving to create a fair competitive development environment for enterprises and innovators from all countries. CNIPA is willing to listen to industry voices, understand the IP needs of foreign-invested enterprises, and do relevant work in a targeted manner. Hart said that in recent years, China's IP protection has made significant progress, providing a good environment for foreign-invested enterprises. AmCham China hopes to maintain communication with CNIPA and will continue to encourage member companies to strengthen confidence and invest in China.

headlines.title: 日本央行数据显示 上周五干预汇市金额约340亿美元
headlines.summary: 据彭博对央行账户的分析，日本上周五可能在汇市投入约340亿美元以支撑日元，这是继前一天行动基础上的持续干预，并与美国进行了协调。此次操作规模估计约为5.33万亿日元（约合340亿美元）。日本财务大臣片山五月周一早些时候确认，日本上周五确实入市干预。美国财政部上周加入了支撑日元的行动，对日本央行账户的分析并未揭示美国在此次市场中干预的规模，但美国的参与可能减少了日本为达到相同汇率效果所需的资金投入。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Japan data shows intervention in FX market on Friday amounted to approximately $34 billion
headlines.summary_en: According to Bloomberg's analysis of central bank accounts, Japan may have spent about $34 billion in the foreign exchange market last Friday to support the yen, following up on intervention from the previous day and coordinated with the United States. The operation is estimated at approximately 5.33 trillion yen (about $34 billion). Japan's Finance Minister Katsunobu Katayama confirmed early Monday that Japan did intervene in the market last Friday. The U.S. Treasury joined actions to support the yen last week; analysis of the Bank of Japan's accounts did not reveal the size of U.S. intervention in that market, but U.S. participation may have reduced the amount Japan needed to spend to achieve the same exchange-rate effect.

headlines.title: 原油LOF易方达：二级市场交易价格溢价风险提示
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月3日讯，原油LOF易方达公告，近期，原油LOF易方达二级市场交易价格明显高于基金份额净值，出现较大幅度溢价。若本基金2026年8月4日二级市场交易价格溢价幅度未有效回落，本基金有权通过向深圳证券交易所申请盘中临时停牌、延长停牌时间及连续停牌等措施，向市场警示风险，具体以届时公告为准。

headlines.title_en: Crude Oil LOF Yifangda: Premium Risk Warning for Secondary Market Trading Prices
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - The Crude Oil LOF E Fund announced that recently, the secondary market trading price of the Crude Oil LOF E Fund has been significantly higher than the fund's net asset value, showing a relatively large premium. If the premium in the secondary market trading price of this fund does not effectively decline on August 4, 2026, the fund has the right to take measures such as applying to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange for intraday temporary suspension, extended suspension, and consecutive suspensions to warn the market of risks, with specific details subject to subsequent announcements.

headlines.title: 得邦照明：重大资产重组实施中，转让股份已完成过户
headlines.summary: 得邦照明公告，公司以支付现金方式受让黄玉琦等15名交易对方持有的嘉利股份6091.71万股股份，并以现金认购嘉利股份新增股份1亿股。本次交易完成后，公司将持有嘉利股份1.61亿股，占其总股本的67.48%。截至目前，本次转让所涉6091.71万股股份已完成过户登记手续；本次定增尚待中国证券登记结算有限责任公司办理新增股份过户登记手续，本次交易尚未实施完毕。

headlines.title_en: Tospo Lighting: Major Asset Restructuring Underway; Share Transfer Registration Completed
headlines.summary_en: Dephy Brand Lighting announced that it will acquire 60.9171 million shares of Jiali Co., Ltd. from 15 transaction counterparties including Huang Yuqi in cash, and will also subscribe to 100 million newly issued shares of Jiali Co., Ltd. in cash. After the transaction is completed, the company will hold 161 million shares of Jiali, accounting for 67.48% of its total share capital. As of now, the transfer of 60.9171 million shares involved has completed the registration procedures; the private placement is still pending the handling of new share transfer registration procedures by the China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation, and the transaction has not yet been fully completed.
